text:
Mara (marketing): Heads-up 1: we need a small creative kit for the benchmark launch + webinar funnel. Scope: 1 hero for the landing page, 4 conversion tiles (variants for three routing goals), an 8-card carousel stitched for social, and a short looping GIF for emails. Deadline: 4 business days. High priority.

Joey (design): Copy and sizes? PNG vs. SVG? Do we need motion for all socials or just the email GIF?

Mara (marketing): Sizes: landing hero 1440x600 (web), social carousel 1080x1350 (portrait) and a landscape 1200x628 hero for paid. Tiles 640x640. GIFs: 1x email GIF 800x418, 2s loop, 24fps max. Keep static exports for ads. Copy options (pick one per creative):
- H1: "Inference that pays off"
- H2: "Lower token spend. Reliable latency."
- Sub: "Live demo + benchmark walkthrough"
CTAs: "Save my spot" / "See benchmark" / "Get results"
Figma master: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/launch-kit-v2 (use artboards under /marketing/bench)

Sam (product): Add a tiny schematic sparkline for "tokens/sec" on the carousel and a micro-table (3 rows) for sample cost points on the landing. Use this sample set for the sparkline so the animation matches numbers:
```
tokens_per_sec: [900, 1200, 1100, 1250, 1180]
cost_per_1k_tokens_usd: [0.95, 0.80, 0.88, 0.76, 0.79]
```
Include a footnote: "Internal benchmark on sample workloads; results vary."

Kai (growth): Routing mapping:
- Variant A (cost-focused) -> /demo?utm=cost_v2
- Variant B (latency-focused) -> /demo?utm=latency_v2
- Variant C (education/explainer) -> /demo?utm=explainer_v2
Each tile needs a hidden input with `utm_campaign=bench_launch_apr` and unique `utm_content` per variant. Also request two CTA treatments per tile for quick A/B: primary full form vs. lightweight "Get results" (no immediate signup).

Joey (design): Noted. Any constraints from brand or legal we should lock before comps? Also confirm accessible color pairs.

Priya (creative): Accessibility callouts: maintain 4.5:1 contrast for body and 3:1 for UI elements at minimum. For one dark tile variant use #071426 background with white text and brand accent #6EE7B7 for sparklines. Buttons: 16px, semibold, 8px radius. For GIF keep motion to a single element (sparkline anim) to reduce visual noise.

Elena (legal): Guidance: no superlatives ("best", "cheapest"). All numeric claims must include attribution as mentioned. If using percentages show sample size: "n=5 runs". Methodology link must be present on the landing and in post-click detail: "Methodology: internal benchmark on sample workloads 14 details at redwood.com/benchmarks". Tag me on the final Figma file and Ill do the quick sweep.

BrandOps Bot: Reminder: include brand palette and font weights in the Figma file. Use primary font Inter 600 for headlines and Inter 400 for body. Upload accessible exports and run contrast check plugin.

Joey (design): Plan: static comps by tomorrow 9:30am PT (3 tile variants + landing hero + carousel cover). GIF prototype (sparkline only) by Wed midday. Ill include an artboard named LEGAL_CHECK with the methodology text locked.

Mara (marketing): Great 7 thanks. After Joey uploads, Ill route to Kai + Elena for approval, then to growth-ops for tag wiring. Please avoid brand language like "inference superiority".

Kai (growth): Also: add two CTA label options in a single artboard layer so we can swap quickly in creatives. And export each tile with metadata file naming: campaign|variant|creativeid.

Joey (design): Will do. Ill add the metadata in a CSV export layer.

Mara (marketing): Final ask: deliver Figma with export-ready slices, a one-page creative spec (fonts, colors, dimensions, export settings), and a short checklist for legal & ops. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

Elena (legal): Ill review once Joey tags me. Quick note: keep the phrase "based on internal benchmarks" consistent across all assets.

Joey (design): Uploading soon.
